definitions: To cause something to explode or to activate a device.
To make something more attractive or noticeable by being placed near it.
To start an event or a series of events.
To compensate for or balance something else.
examples: We set off early in the morning.
The fireworks were set off at midnight.
The new curtains set off the room beautifully.
His comments set off a heated debate.
The tax relief will set off some of the costs.
